job.question: What was the proposal deadline in the Hawaii ERS RFP for private equity consulting services published in 2017?
job.acceptance: November27,2017 at 4:30pm HST; equivalent date/time format accepted.

reviews.reason: This is a 2016 South Carolina RSIC RFP for general investment consulting, not the 2017 Hawaii ERS RFP for private equity consulting. Its proposal deadline therefore does not support the requested deadline.
quotes: South Carolina Retirement System Investment Commission General Investment Consulting Services RFP
Deadline for Proposal Submission December 1, 2016 – 5:00 p.m. EST
